newsitem.title: FRANCE: Syrian leaders visit Algiers for Arab support.
newsitem.headline: Syrian leaders visit Algiers for Arab support.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual on Sunday pledged support for Syria's stand on talks with Israel in the Middle East peace process, Syria's Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam was quoting as saying.

"Syria is ready for the talks with Israel on the condition that the negotiations begin from the point where they broke (last year)... President Zeroual backs Syria in this position," said Khaddam speaking on the Algerian state-run radio after a meeting with Zeroual.
Khaddam reiterated that Damascus would resume negotiations with the Jewish state only after the Israel agreed to return the Golan Heights, captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
Khaddam and Syria's Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara arrived in Algiers earlier on Sunday to build up support for Syria's stand in the Middle East peace process.

Israel broke off talks after a wave of Islamist bombings in Israel last February and March. The resumption is stymied by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's refusal to negotiate the return of land.
